subject: general
question: Which of the following is nuclear-powered submarine?
solution:
The correct answer is __**INS Arihant**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **INS Arihant** is India's first indigenously developed nuclear-powered submarine.
 
• The submarine is part of the Indian Navy's Advanced Technology Vessel (ATV) project.
 
• It was launched on 26 July 2009 and commissioned into service in August 2016.
 
• INS Arihant provides India with a credible second-strike capability, enhancing the country's strategic deterrence.
 
• The submarine is equipped with nuclear-tipped ballistic missiles, making it a crucial asset in India's defense strategy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **INS Shalki**, **INS Sindhuvir**, and **INS Kalvari** are other submarines in the Indian Navy but are not nuclear-powered.
 
• **INS Shalki** is a diesel-electric submarine of the Shishumar class.
 
• **INS Sindhuvir** is a Kilo-class diesel-electric submarine.
 
• **INS Kalvari** is a Scorpene-class diesel-electric submarine.
 
• Nuclear-powered submarines have a significant strategic advantage due to their ability to remain submerged for extended periods without surfacing.
 
• They play a critical role in maintaining stealth and ensuring the effectiveness of a nation's naval deterrent capabilities.
